def union_elements(tup1: tuple, tup2: tuple):
    """
    Returns the sorted union of elements from two tuples.
    
    Example:
        assert union_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10)
    """
    # Convert to sets for efficient unique combination, then sort and convert back to tuple
    return tuple(sorted(set(tup1).union(set(tup2))))


# Test the function as per the requirement
if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert union_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10)

def union_elements(tup1: tuple, tup2: tuple):
    """
    Returns the sorted union of elements from two tuples.
    
    Example:
        assert union_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10)
    """
    # Convert to sets for efficient unique combination, then sort and convert back to tuple
    return tuple(sorted(set(tup1).union(set(tup2))))


# Test the function as per the requirement
assert union_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10)) == (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10)
